note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 2.3 and HEAD code (packet.go VerifyCoARequestAuth, Decode, VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator; coa.go serveRequests). The positive half of TestRFC5176LengthFieldGovernsTheOctetsRead isolates trailing padding (8 zero octets past Length still get Disconnect-ACK, whereas reading past Length fails auth and decode). The negative half fails Question 3 (cascade-confounded buffer) and Question 2: slicing wire[:len(wire)-4] invalidates Request Authenticator MD5 (computed over len(wire) bytes) and truncates the final 6-byte Event-Timestamp TLV to 2 bytes, so an implementation that clamps pktLen to len(data) ('reads to the end of what arrived') still silently discards and passes green; furthermore, removing pktLen > len(data) panics on data[:pktLen] and serveRequests taskguard.Contain silently drops pre-admission panics, passing sendRawCoAPacketExpectNoResponse. Fix owed: construct a datagram with complete attributes of N bytes, Length set to N+4, and authenticators signed over the N arrived bytes (plus direct Decode/Verify unit checks), asserting silence and no extra teardown.
